description: Free conversion / Zero government fee for unnotified land up to 25 cents (10.11 ares) converted before 2008.
statutory_citation: Kerala Conservation of Paddy Land & Wetland Act, 2008, Section 27A(3) Proviso & G.O.(P) No. 167/2020/RD

description: 10% of the notified fair value of the land for extents between 25 and 50 cents (10.11 to 20.23 ares).
statutory_citation: Section 27A(3) read with Schedule to Act 28 of 2008 (Amended 2018)

description: 20% of the notified fair value of the land for extents between 50 cents and 1 acre (20.23 to 40.47 ares).
statutory_citation: Section 27A(3) read with Schedule to Act 28 of 2008 (Amended 2018)

description: 30% of the notified fair value of the land for extents exceeding 1 acre (above 40.47 ares).
statutory_citation: Section 27A(3) read with Schedule to Act 28 of 2008 (Amended 2018)
